tables.title: Test-Set Performance
notes: Trained on 142 cases, tested on 47 held-out cases (25%, seed 123).
R² is 1 − SSE/SST on the test set and can be negative for a poor model.

tables.title: Variable Importance
notes: Permutation importance: rise in test RMSE when the predictor is shuffled.

tables.title: Coefficients
notes: Penalized estimates: no standard errors or p-values. A coefficient of 0 means the variable was dropped.
Standardized = change per one SD of the predictor.

assumptions.message: Training and test errors are close.

interpretation.text: A lasso regression predicting birth_weight from 8 predictors had a test-set RMSE of 614.50 and explained 9.1% of the variance in 47 held-out cases (MAE = 529.10). The most important predictor was uterine_irritability.

title: Regularized Regression
code:
library(ggnext)
# Lasso (regression): birth_weight ~ age + mother_weight + preterm + visits + race + smoke + hypertension + uterine_irritability
predictors <- c("age", "mother_weight", "preterm", "visits", "race", "smoke", "hypertension", "uterine_irritability")
d <- data[complete.cases(data[, c("birth_weight", predictors)]), c("birth_weight", predictors), drop = FALSE]
d$race <- factor(d$race, levels = c(1, 2, 3), labels = c("White", "Black", "Other"))
d$smoke <- factor(d$smoke, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
d$hypertension <- factor(d$hypertension, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
d$uterine_irritability <- factor(d$uterine_irritability, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
# Hold out 25% of the cases to test the model
set.seed(123)
test_rows <- sample(nrow(d), round(0.25 * nrow(d)))
train <- d[-test_rows, , drop = FALSE]
test <- d[test_rows, , drop = FALSE]
# glmnet needs a numeric matrix: dummy-code the categorical predictors
design <- function(newdata) model.matrix(~ ., data = newdata[predictors])[, -1, drop = FALSE]
set.seed(123)
cv <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(design(train), train$birth_weight, family = "gaussian", alpha = 1, nfolds = 10)
lambda <- cv$lambda.min
fit <- cv$glmnet.fit
predict_fn <- function(newdata) as.numeric(predict(fit, design(newdata), s = lambda))
coefs <- as.matrix(coef(fit, s = lambda))[, 1]
coef_tbl <- data.frame(term = names(coefs), estimate = unname(coefs))
coef_tbl$standardized <- c(NA, coefs[-1] * apply(design(train), 2, sd))   # per SD of the predictor
cv_curve <- data.frame(log_lambda = log(cv$lambda), error = cv$cvm, lower = cv$cvlo, upper = cv$cvup, nonzero = cv$nzero)
# Performance on the held-out test set
pred <- predict_fn(test)
rmse <- sqrt(mean((test$birth_weight - pred)^2))
mae <- mean(abs(test$birth_weight - pred))
r2 <- 1 - sum((test$birth_weight - pred)^2) / sum((test$birth_weight - mean(test$birth_weight))^2)
train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train$birth_weight - predict_fn(train))^2))
# Permutation importance: rise in test RMSE when one predictor is shuffled (mean of 10 shuffles)
score <- function(data) -sqrt(mean((data$birth_weight - predict_fn(data))^2))
set.seed(123)
importance <- sapply(predictors, function(v) mean(replicate(10, {
  shuffled <- test
  shuffled[[v]] <- sample(shuffled[[v]])
  score(test) - score(shuffled)
})))
importance <- sort(importance, decreasing = TRUE)
p_cv <- ggnext(cv_curve, aes(log_lambda, error, ymin = lower, ymax = upper)) +
  geom_errorbar() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log(lambda), dash = "4 4") +
  labs(title = "Cross-validated error by penalty", x = "log(λ)", y = "Cross-validated error") +
  theme_modern()
importance_df <- data.frame(variable = names(importance), importance = as.numeric(importance))[seq_len(min(length(importance), 20)), ]
importance_df$variable <- factor(importance_df$variable, levels = rev(importance_df$variable))
# Names are drawn inside the panel, left of the data (ggnext clips long axis labels)
label_pad <- min(0.5, (max(nchar(as.character(importance_df$variable))) * 7 + 12) / 500)
importance_df$label_x <- min(0, importance_df$importance) - (max(importance_df$importance) - min(0, importance_df$importance)) * label_pad / (1 - label_pad)
p_importance <- ggnext(importance_df, aes(importance, variable)) +
  geom_importance() +
  geom_text(aes(x = label_x, y = variable, label = variable), anchor = "start") +
  labs(title = "Variable importance", x = "Importance") +
  theme(axis_title_y = FALSE, axis_text_y = FALSE, base = theme_modern())
fit_df <- data.frame(observed = test$birth_weight, predicted = pred)
p_performance <- ggnext(fit_df, aes(predicted, observed)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, dash = "4 4") +
  labs(title = "Observed vs predicted (test set)", x = "Predicted", y = "Observed") +
  theme_modern()
